messages:
Marie (Growth): quick ask — we need three compact hero GIF variants for the webinar landing page and a one-pager for SDRs. deadline: next Wed EOD. can design confirm sizes and any localization needs?
Diego (Design): ok — I can do 3 variants: static hero, looping GIF (8s), and a 2-frame micro-animation. target sizes?
Sam (Product Marketing): targeting: hero for web (1200x628), social cut (1080x1080), and email header (600x200). file-size cap: 250KB for email, 500KB for web GIFs.
Diego (Design): noted. localization: en/us, en/uk, de, fr. will do text layers so translators can swap copy. need final copy from PM by Fri.
Tess (Legal): quick flag — partner logos on one-pager require approved lockups. send the partner list now if you plan to include them. also watch type usage on EU localized versions (no claim language).
Nate (Sales Ops): @Marie if we include routing rules on the one-pager, can you add the lead scoring thresholds? Sales wants: MQL -> AE-queue, webinar signups with demo intent -> SDR-priority. also need form names for GTM tracking.
Marie (Growth): adding routing bullets: form=webinar_short, utm_campaign=webinar_may, demo_intent checkbox -> SDR-priority. attaching brief in a bit.
Diego (Design): asset naming + export prefs below — follow these exactly to keep build consistent:
```
web-hero_variantA_1200x628_v1.gif
web-hero_variantB_1200x628_v1.gif
social-hero_variantA_1080x1080_v1.png
email-header_600x200_v1.gif
sales-onepager_v1.pdf
```
Export notes: gifs dithered, 128 colors, web gifs ≤500KB, email headers ≤250KB, PDFs <=1MB for CRM upload.
asset-bot: assets folder created: https://assets.redwood.ai/webinars/may-2026/web-hero-pack/ (private)
Sam (Product Marketing): for AB we want: Variant A focuses on latency-cost headline, Variant B focuses on trust + SLA. small copy variants attached — please embed as text layers.
Tess (Legal): sending approved partner logo files in a minute. also here's a short checklist to include in design handoff: full-color lockup, mono lockup, clearspace guidelines, hex & RGB swatches, permissible tagline language for EU.
Diego (Design): will follow checklist. ETA: first pass by Tue midday, final by Wed EOD assuming copy + logos arrive.
Marie (Growth): perfect. priority = hero GIFs > sales one-pager > social cuts. thank you — @Nate I'll ping once assets are uploaded for routing test. :thumbsup:
Nate (Sales Ops): cool — will test routing with dev on Thurs. pls include test creds if you add CRM fields.
Diego (Design): added test layer README in asset folder with CRM field names and lead form sample.
Marie (Growth): closing this thread — will update if any scope change. :party-parrot:
